text:
maria: Heads-up — we’re seeing a spike in east-west packet loss between rack12 and neighboring racks, started ~09:07 UTC. GPU jobs are timing out intermittently. Anyone near the ToR telemetry?

net-monitor-bot: ALERT: BGP adjacency flaps detected on top-of-rack-rack12 (leaf12). 3 flaps in 6m. Link: https://monitoring.redwood/alerts/leaf12-bgp-flap

kevin: Yep, I’m seeing gRPC streams reset / RDMA connection resets from pods scheduled on nodes in rack12. High tail latency on infer nodes.

jamal: Can someone SSH into one of the affected hosts and grab `ip link` and `ethtool -S`? Might be a NIC level issue or MTU.

kevin: Quick snippet from node gpu-node-12-07: 
```
$ ip link show eth0
3: eth0: <BROADCAST,MULTICAST,UP,LOWER_UP> mtu 1500 qdisc mq state UP mode DEFAULT group default qlen 1000

$ ethtool -S eth0 | head -n 10
rx_errors: 124
tx_errors: 0
rx_dropped: 32
rx_crc_errors: 0
rx_frame_errors: 12
```
Looks like RX errors + drops. MTU is 1500 on host. ToR might be doing jumbo frames elsewhere (1500 vs 9000 mismatch?).

rachel: tcpdump on leaf12 interface (mirror): 
```
10:23:45.123456 IP 10.2.12.7 > 10.2.13.9: Frag needed and DF set (mtu 1500)
10:23:45.123789 IP 10.2.13.9 > 10.2.12.7: tcp 0
```
Seeing ICMP fragmentation needed messages. Some flows get fragmented or dropped.

dmitri: That pattern + BGP flaps smells like ECMP path churn causing re-ordering. RDMA (RoCE) is very sensitive. If packets bounce across different ToRs or transits with different MTU/queues you'll see resets. We hit this exact symptom in eu-central last quarter.

operations-bot: Action: started automated draining of GPU pool in rack12 and scaled up spare capacity in racks 14 & 15. Scaling events: scale-up-ops-1765432.

maria: Temporary mitigation applied: pinned new jobs away from rack12, disabled ECMP hashing on leaf12 for src/dst pairs to force single path while we debug. Not ideal but reduced error rate. @kevin can you validate job stability?

kevin: After pinning & disabling ECMP on leaf12 I see DROP rate drop ~85% and RDMA resets stop for the pinned jobs. Jobs that remained on rack12 still show occasional `gRPC: connection reset by peer`.

jamal: Please try toggling NIC GRO/GSO — sometimes large offloads interact badly with RDMA on mismatched MTU. Recommended commands to test (one-off):
```
sudo ethtool -K eth0 rx off tx off gro off gso off tso off
sudo ifconfig eth0 mtu 9000
```
But careful — setting mtu 9000 host-side without ToR support will worsen fragmentation.

rachel: Checked ToR stats: interface 4/1 on leaf12 has high `tx_errors` and `rx_crc_errors`, also elevated queue drops on egress. Hardware shows port flaps correlate with the BGP logs. Possible transceiver or cable issue.

maria: Ops note: we should avoid touching MTU cluster-wide during business hours. Plan: swap ToR PSU + check SFP on 4/1 during maintenance window 02:00 UTC. Dmitri can you draft runbook + rollback?

dmitri: On it. I'll include steps: 1) move active flows off leaf12 -> 2) replace SFP & verify optics 3) bring interface up with monitoring and BFD/BGP timers tightened 4) re-enable ECMP and observe. I'll also add `iperf3` test steps and RDMA stress (`rping`) for validation.

kevin: FYI customer impact: two Dedicated clusters (cust-audio, cust-vision) hit higher tail latency and reported ~3% request errors in last 30m. Filed incident INC-2026 and notified CS.

maria: Thanks. For postmortem include cost impact from emergency scale-up (extra GPU hours) and SLA hit window. Also include proposed permanent fix (optics/cable replacements + MTU harmonization and BFD tuning).

operations-bot: Maintenance job created: MAINT-1765432 scheduled 2026-03-19 02:00 UTC.

dmitri: Will run pre-checks 1h prior and post-checks 30m after. I'll post the postmortem template in #postmortems once we finish.

maria: Good progress. Keep updates here; if anything changes tag @oncall. :thumbsup:
